shots.text: There was no dawn. There has not been one since.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Solenne under a black sky, lit by torches and the Heartstone's faint six-coloured pulse.

shots.text: I hold court by voice now. I have learned which footsteps are good news.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde on her throne, blindfold of black and gold, Fennick's brass measuring rod across her knees. Heroes standing in the dim hall.

shots.text: He kept notes. Pages and pages of them. Fire burns, water slows. I'll read them to you, Spirewright. Badly.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin at a war table under a lantern, reading from Fennick's battered notebook with his spectacles in her hand.

shots.text:
Out on the roads, in the dark, we kept losing cities. And we kept saving their people.

It was the only thing we were still good at.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A night road lit by a line of lanterns: refugees, carts, Lanternguard, towers glowing in six colours along the way.
